title: Anyone else’s dreamscapes being affected by seeing coverage of Palestine?
content: I was in mall world again last night, trying to gather supplies and dodge people who were gonna kill me. Made very close friends with some. We were making do. Empty cityscapes, little potable water, a deep feeling of fear within me. Felt apocalyptic. I haven’t ever watched a genocide in real time like I have with this one. The victims have been posting on TikTok until they die. Seeing people beg for their lives while I take a bathroom break at work. People mourning their children. Like the hyper-consumerism that led to malls, it all feels very dystopian. As I see others on here say they haven’t visited mall world in a while, maybe this is why?
